reports.title: GOODRX REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS AND PROVIDES UPDATE ON

guidance.heading: Guidance
section: Management is raising its full-year 2026 guidance as follows:

$ in millions | FY 2026 | FY 2025 | YoY Change
Revenue | $844 - $850 | $796.9 | 6% - 7%
Adjusted EBITDA2 | $280 - $286 | $270.5 | 4% - 6%
“We delivered third quarter revenue of $218.4 million and Adjusted EBITDA1 of $74.5 million, as Pharma Direct and
subscriptions continued to perform well,” said Justin Fengler, Chief Financial Officer and Chief Strategy & Operations Officer
of GoodRx. “We are raising our full-year revenue and Adjusted EBITDA2 guidance, which incorporates the restatement of
our first and second quarter results, and expect 2026 to be a record year for both measures.”
2.Adjusted EBITDA is a non-GAAP financial measure and is presented for supplemental informational purposes only. We have not reconciled our Adjusted
EBITDA guidance to GAAP net income or loss because we do not provide guidance for such GAAP measure due to the uncertainty and potential variability of
